item.title: M.C. Saimin Kenkyuu
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Staffing
  • 発売日: 2017-10-13
  • スコア: 6.42/10 (43 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Ｍ．Ｃ．催眠研究
  • 英語名: M.C. Saimin Kenkyuu

别名

  • M.C.催眠研究case真志保

あらすじ

「Common sense, preference, thought. If you can control another person’s “spirit” as much as you want, what will you do?」

The protagonist Takesato Masaru is a high school sophomore. He is the only remaining member of the cucumber research club. He always having fun during after school, where he can quietly read the books left by his senior at the club room.

  • 日本語名: 催眠演舞
  • 英語名: Saimin Enbu

别名

  • Hypnotic Dance Performance

あらすじ

Kagura Kazusa always trained to inherit the traditional dance style and traditions of his family.

However, he’s rejected by his grandfather, who decides that his cousin, Katsura Kaguya, is a better choice.

After that, for a long time, he loses the will to live, just going by day by day, until he meets Urakawa Yanagi in his school’s magic show.

item.title: Saimin Yuugi
item.description:

  • 日本語名: 催眠遊戯
  • 英語名: Saimin Yuugi

别名

  • Saimin Yuhgi

あらすじ

Urakawa Yanagi favorite past-time is doing magic tricks involving coins, making them appear, disappear and move around in various ways.

He loves to entertain his classmates with his tricks.

As the Christmas vacations approaches, he look for a new trick to show everybody, and settle for hypnotism.

Where will his practice lead him?
